messages.subject: Circumvent 12 Column Bootstrap Limit
parts: Bootstrap has a 12 column limit and the any widgets after column 12 unattractively wrap onto a new line. I have a design where I need 14 columns. It is possible to make a custom Bootstrap style at http://getbootstrap.com/customize/ but how can it be integrated with a single Shiny application ?

messages.author: a5edeb4fa89b826c
messages.subject: Re: Circumvent 12 Column Bootstrap Limit
parts:
One solution would be to use the CSS flexbox layout.  It's described in detail here https://css-tricks.com/snippets/css/a-guide-to-flexbox/ , but, basically, you'll need CSS that does these things:

1.  Apply "display: flex;" to a container element (such as a div) that contains the 14 items.  Note that the default is "nowrap"; if you want wrapping, then you'll need to also apply "flex-wrap: wrap;" to the container.  You may also want something like "justify-content: space-between;" or "justify-content: space-around;" to evenly space your 14 items within the container element.

2.  Apply something like "flex: 0 0 auto;" to your items within the container if you don't want them to grow and shrink or something like "flex: 1 1 auto;" if you do want your items to grow and shrink with the available horizontal space.

Joel
